Container.Name: rgb-commander-studio
Container.Overview: Design button lighting schemes and animations for RGBcommander (Ultimarc I-PAC Ultimate I/O and PacLED64) in your browser, with live previews of how the LEDs will glow. Published .rgba files are written to a share, ready for Syncthing to carry to your arcade cabinet.
Container.Requires: Syncthing (or another sync tool) sharing the output folder with the cabinet.

Config.Name: Output folder (.rgba files for Syncthing)
Config.Description: Published .rgba files are written here. Share this folder with your cabinet in Syncthing so it lands in RGBcommander's rgba folder.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Schemes, panel layout, settings and backups of replaced files.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. When set, the web UI asks for user 'admin' and this password.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app writes files as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app writes files as (100 = users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for new files. 002 makes them group-writable; use 000 if another container runs as a different user and needs to change them.
